info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Loyalty Loyalty Tiers-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Tier Lookup API allows businesses to retrieve details about their loyalty program tiers. This endpoint provides information on the different levels of loyalty tiers available, including benefits and requirements for customers. Typical consumers of this API include customer relationship management systems and mobile applications that manage user interactions with loyalty rewards. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance user experiences and optimize customer engagement strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current loyalty tier details and benefits associated with it for a user based on their loyalty program status.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to retrieve loyalty tier information, specifically designed for operations when making a GET request. It should define the necessary parameters required to fetch the relevant loyalty tier details.
